title: A ratio tile with hours on one day only shows an empty chart outline
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. The Dash Shop data set exists, all created today in location ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop, where nothing else is invoiced or clocked this month: work order 1 for customer ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Fleet, Service Advisor ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X, one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.50 and technician ZZAUTOTEST Tech One, a part with Sell Price $50.00, and ZZAUTOTEST Tech One clocked exactly 2.50 hours on it; work order 2 for ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Fleet, Service Advisor ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y, one labor line of 1.00 hour at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.00 and technicians ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two, a part with Sell Price $160.00, Tech One clocked exactly 0.25 hours and Tech Two exactly 0.75 hours on it. Neither work order has shop supplies, a fee or a discount; both are invoiced and not paid. Totals: invoices $250.00 and $260.00; 3.00 labor hours billed; 2.50 technician hours on the lines; 3.50 clocked hours; no internal (non work order) time.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: if ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop already exists with exactly this data, reuse it. Otherwise: (a) location: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. (b) staff: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member, four times: ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two with Role Technician and Time Clock on, ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X and ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y with Role Service Advisor; each with Location ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop and a Department > Save & Close. Give each technician an email address you can open: they must accept the invitation email and set a password so you can sign in as them in a private window. (c) customers: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save, for ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Fleet and ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Fleet. (d) each work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = the technician(s), Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time and Tech Time as above, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; set Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; on the line click Add Part and add a part with the Sell Price above (it must show In stock, or be ordered and received, before you can invoice). (e) clocked time: sign in as each technician in a private window > open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out; then, as Admin, the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows). (f) on each work order: on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
custom_steps:
1. Change location to ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop (profile icon > Change Location) and click Dashboard in the top menu (every tile on This Month).
  2. Look at the trend-line area of Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization.
  3. Read the three headlines and supporting lines.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • All clocked time is on one day, so each ratio tile has only one day with a value. Each shows a dashed outline with a small line-chart icon in its middle, sitting where the trend line would be instead of a trend line.
  • The headlines and supporting lines are unchanged by the outline: Billing Efficiency 85.71% with "3.00 Invoiced / 3.50 Clocked", Technician Efficiency 71.43% with "2.50 Invoiced Tech Hrs / 3.50 Clocked", Technician Utilization 100.00% with "3.50 WO Hrs / 3.50 Clocked".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 4. Design canvas board 15_Empty_Design (row 15).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R12: “A tile shows the empty-chart placeholder in place of its sparkline when fewer than two points in the selected range have a value.”
  • S4-R18: “The placeholder changes nothing else on the tile. The headline and the supporting line show their usual values.”
